description_en: Performs statistics on all jobs that are complete on a specified day and obtains the total resource usage of each job executor on a daily basis
description_zh: 指定时间范围内，针对已结束的全部作业进行统计，以“天”为级别展示作业执行者级别的资源使用总量
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute get-job-resource-usage --date 2023-05-15 --job-owner-list ALIYUN_xxx@test.aliyunid.com --quota-nickname-list my_quota --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobResourceUsage

parameters.description_en: The date that is accurate to the day part for the query. The date must be in the yyyy-MM-dd format.
parameters.description_zh: 查询的日期，以天为级别，时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_en: The date that is accurate to the day part for the query. The date must be in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 查询的日期，以天为级别，时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: date

parameters.description_en: The list of nicknames of quotas that are used by jobs.
parameters.description_zh: 作业使用的配额昵称列表
parameters.help_en: The list of nicknames of quotas that are used by jobs
parameters.help_zh: 作业使用的配额昵称列表
parameters.name: quota_nickname_list

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.
parameters.description_zh: 每页返回数目，默认为10，最大为100
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数目，默认为10，最大为100
